items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I had an engagement at the Eden Hotel, for another Mr. Lehmann, and that was another six months.

ctx.x: And there was no problem. I stayed after my six months at the Barberina. I had an engagement at the Eden Hotel, for another Mr. Lehmann, and that was another six months.
Well, this was the same band that you recorded with?
